_readme: Ground truth for retrieval_eval.py. Written by hand from the real PDFs in data/.
Each question is anchored to an 'answer_snippet' — a verbatim phrase from the source document.
At eval time the harness finds every chunk containing that snippet and treats those as the
relevant set. Anchoring on text rather than hardcoded chunk numbers means the ground truth
survives re-chunking, and the harness fails loudly if a snippet no longer resolves.
type = 'exact_keyword': the question contains a distinctive literal token (proper noun,
number, product name) that appears verbatim in the target chunk. BM25 should do well here.
type = 'semantic': the question paraphrases the idea with no distinctive literal anchor.
GA3.pdf is excluded — its pages are images, so text extraction yields near-empty chunks.
Gen_AI.pdf, Pushkar CV.pdf and abhishek_data_analyst_resume.pdf are excluded because they
are CVs containing third-party personal data. No question here contains a personal name,
